text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For an Umamusume, the moment you
encounter your racewear is akin
to a date
with destiny.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
None believe this more than Beauty
Anshinzawa, a designer who dubs these
encounters "engagements" and creates
racewear inspired by
wedding dresses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This year, she's once again holding the
Beauty Dream Cup to decide who gets to
don her latest dresses, and every
Umamusume is eager to try their luck at
the auditions.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A striking black that can't be colored
over
by someone else... Curren,
your dress
really makes your cuteness shine.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Thanks! ♪ You're pretty
cute yourself, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know, I've been really looking forward
to this unveiling race. I
can't wait to show
everyone the new Curren—the cutest in the
universe!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well, you'll have to best me to do that!
After all, in this wedding
dress, I have no
choice but to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One month ago, at the Beauty Dream Cup
muse audition press
conference...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Beauty, please tell us more about this
year's Beauty Dream Cup in
Japan!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm very excited to meet some new lovely
gems! And stay tuned to see
some
absolutely stunning wedding dress
racewear again this year!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Beauty, am I right to assume that
you've prepared another elaborate
audition to select the models that'll wear
your racewear and run in the unveiling
race?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Doing the same audition every year would
be rather dull, wouldn't it? A muse is
someone who can display brilliance even in
the face of
unfamiliar challenges. ♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That is why... this year, I'll have all my
muse candidates take on a
team-based
riddle audition!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The theme is, "Those who strive for beauty
must also possess
intellect"! I eagerly await
the participation of undiscovered 
diamonds! ♪

text_block_list.name: Charismatic Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey, wanna join my team? I just have to get my hands on one of Beauty Anshinzawa's latest dresses!

text_block_list.name: Peppy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! We promised each other we'd
both become muses, and
that's what we're
gonna do!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Why, everyone is in a right uproar! It
appears the audition has fully
captured
the attention of all.

text_block_list.name: Captain of Security
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that makes sense. Surely racers
themselves would put a lot
of thought into
what they wear on the track.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. Still, how should I put it?
Everyone's enthusiasm is far
beyond what I
had expected.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Their fervor...
It feels as if this means more
to them than a simple
article of clothing...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Fine! You got some time right
now?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Greetings,
Curren. Is it about the audition,
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you know me too well, Fine. That's
right—I'm recruiting team
members for the
audition!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Fine? The rules say you
need five to enter, and I've got
an open
spot if you're interested.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In truth,
I only intended to spectate... but
would you mind if I asked
you a question?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Why do you wish to enter the audition? Is
your goal the racewear? Or
perhaps you
aspire to be a model?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm entering so I can win myself Beauty
Anshinzawa's wedding dress racewear.
With that on,
I'll definitely be the cutest in
the universe!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(So it's the racewear that drives her
actions...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Curren, you're planning to go
seek out more members,
right? Would you
mind if I accompanied you?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the offer. To tell you the
truth, I'd been looking to
acquire Ms.
Beauty's racewear as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
From what I've heard, her racewear's
functionality and performance
are
top-class, to say nothing of her dazzling
designs.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Getting that racewear will surely help
prolong my running career...
I've
decided—I'll work with you to pass the
audition!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? You want us to join your team?
But... I'll probably just mess
things up for
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Why's that? Come on, let's take on that
audition together! Just think
of Ms.
Beauty's racewear—twinkly and sooo cute!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Rice, didn't you say you've always looked
up to these mewsies?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's right. When I was little,
I saw the
Beauty Dream Cup on TV
once...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And everyone watching the muses run in
their wedding dresses
looked so happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I remember thinking how nice it was, and
from then on, I watched the cup every
year.
I even hoped that one day I'd get the
chance to be a muse, too...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Then what're you waiting for?! I wanna run
in the Beauty Dream Cup
with you, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I bet it'd be a tooon of fun to run with
everyone! So let's do it! First
place, here
we come!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Y-yeah, you're right! Um, Curren! We
accept your offer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Ikuno, Rice, Urara—they all agreed
to join my team!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Curren, I found this a little strange, but
how did you decide who to
reach out to
beforehand?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Instead of looking for any Umamusume
interested in the audition, you
were set on
Ikuno and the others from the start,
weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's simple. Those three are just as
serious as I am about
winning, that's all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: By "serious," you mean...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's what it sounds like. Take Ikuno, for
example. She was interested in the
performance of the racewear, right?
Mentioned prolonging her career. Well,
you see...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno perfectly maintains her cleats,
shoes, and other racing equipment every
day. For her, the racewear is another step
towards
achieving her goal.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: She's serious about running for as long as she can.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And Rice, she's been interested in the
muses for a long time. To her,
they're
Umamusume who can bring smiles to
everyone watching.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Rather than the racewear's design, Rice is
more interested in making the people
around her smile. And I believe that wish
of hers is the
real deal.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
As for Urara, her desire to run with
everyone is pure and genuine,
stronger
than anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If I want to get my hands on the
universe's
cutest racewear, then I
couldn't ask for a
better team, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(She really thought this through...
To think
racewear could mean so
much to so
many...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Captain? Upon discovering everyone's
aspirations, I have determined it my duty
to help them realize those ambitions. As
such, may I have your permission to join
them?

text_block_list.name: Captain of Security
text_block_list.text:
This year's audition will be judged based
on "intellect." Riddles are
unlikely to pose
any danger, so there should be no
problem with your participation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Curren, I have an earnest request to make
of you. Would you please
allow me to join
your team for the audition?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Geez! You're always so dense when it
comes to important stuff like
this, Fine!
Remember who I invited first?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You were the first person I thought of to
recruit for the audition! ♪
Anyways, we're
a team now, so let's show 'em what we've
got!
